text: A regular expression can check that brackets in a string are correctly nested.
explanation: Nesting is context-free and regular expressions recognise regular languages, so the general case is impossible rather than merely difficult — no cleverness with the syntax helps. That is the exact boundary behind the perennial failure to parse HTML with a regex. Within a line, for a token-shaped pattern, a regex is the right tool; the moment matching depends on counting depth, you need a stack.
